text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-48321 fired for service="inference-gateway.prod" — symptom="5xx error-rate spike". Alert: 5xx rate > 8% over 2m window. Severity=high. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-48321
maya: acked — I'm on it, looking at metrics and logs now.
jackson: I see a sharp bump in 502/503 from the edge LB in us-east1 and eu-west1 starting ~2m ago. Grafana panel: https://grafana/inference/errors?from=-5m
sara: any recent deploys or infra changes? CI bot: no prod deploys in last 30m.
opsbot: Autoscaler attempted to add 3 nodes to dedicated-pool-prod at 2498765408 and got quota/provision error:```
Error: provider API returned 403 QuotaExceeded for request create-vm
stack: /infra/autoscale/handler.go:142
```
maya: ok runbook step 1: check gateway pods and tail logs on a sample host. Running: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-gateway`
eli: I can try a quick routing fallback — route a small fraction to fallback-model:inference-small (lower memory config) to reduce pressure on large model nodes. We have smart-routing policy ready.
maya: running restart on canary pods to clear potential stuck KV cache:```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway-canary -n prod
# output: deployment.apps/inference-gateway-canary restarted
```
jackson: support note: ticketing shows a handful of enterprise customers in eu-west1 seeing elevated 502s (~3% of their requests). Escalating to support@.
product-signal: flagged product-impact for top-3 customers, prepping customer comms if this persists > 30m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty attempted auto-escalation after 5 minutes; PD reported webhook timeout to slack at 2498765460 (was queued).
maya: ack propagation hiccup — I manually confirmed ack in PD and pinned the incident in channel.
sara: opsbot logs show repeated KV cache stalls and a spike of long-tail tokenization times from the tokenizer service; might be upstream backpressure.
opsbot: Applied temporary per-route rate-limit and request queueing for `/v1/generate` to protect backend:```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "rate_limit": "500rps",
  "burst": 200,
  "queue_timeout_ms": 1200
}
```
eli: routing fallback applied for 8% of traffic to fallback-model at 2498765488. Monitoring impact.
maya: after canary restart and routing fallback, error rate fell from 9.8% -> 1.4% over next 3m. Live graph: https://grafana/inference/errors?from=-1m&to=now
jackson: continuing to see a residual tail in eu-west1 — likely due to LB draining. Kicking an explicit drain and re-add for two problem nodes.
product-signal: support notified top customers with brief note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xxs; mitigations in progress; we'll follow up with timeline and root cause."
oncall-manager: leaving a note — good containment. Please keep incident open for postmortem and add logs, autoscale failure traces, and PD webhook timing to the ticket. We'll reconvene for a 60-min blameless review.
maya: adding checklist items: 1) collect pod logs for 2498765400-2498765520, 2) export autoscaler request/response, 3) snapshot LB metrics and connection counts, 4) capture PD webhook logs.
sara: small follow-up: can we suppress future pages for transient spikes shorter than 90s? PD rule is 2m but slackbot debounce misfired here once due to webhook lag. Recommend: PD -> slack debounce 3 attempts within 60s = single channel message.
oncall-manager: agreed. Add suppression tuning and runbook entry about manual ack propagation if PD webhook fails.
opsbot: created a temporary ticket AUTOSCALE-789 for quota reconfiguration and added a note to the dedicated pool owner.
maya: monitoring stable, error-rate under 1.5% for 10m; keeping the fallback routing live for 20m to ensure warmup.
jackson: will follow up with a short incident summary for CST and escalate to infra for quota fix.
incident-bot: closing auto-update: incident PD-48321 status=resolved (mitigated) at 2498765545.
maya: closing from oncall — filing postmortem and runbook updates. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
product-signal: adding customers contacted and proposed follow-up timeline to the incident ticket.
oncall-manager: assigning postmortem owner: maya. Please include remediation for autoscale quota and PD->slack debounce change.
sara: created a small pager rule RFC and linked it to the ticket: https://docs.internal/pager-rules/rfc-debounce
maya: noted — will open PR to runbook after capturing logs.
